title: Cap. IX Arg. 10: if election and reprobation hang on mere liberty of will, Gospel preaching to the reprobate becomes from God's precise intention a ministry of condemnation
pass_a_gloss: If we place election and reprobation as hanging from the mere liberty of the Divine will, and not from the discriminated acts of the elect and reprobate themselves (namely the penitence of these, the impenitence of those, the persevering faith of these, the final unbelief of those): then the preaching of the Gospel as to the reprobate from the nearest and precise intention of God will be a ministry of condemnation, and will not be proposed unto them from the first intention of God unto working their salvation, but as a medium in executing the decree of reprobation subordinated unto damnation. But this directly fights with the ministry of the Gospel, inasmuch as from the first intention of God it is a ministry of life.
pass_b_english: If we set election and reprobation as hanging on mere liberty of divine will — not on the differing acts of elect and reprobate themselves (these' penitence, those' impenitence; these' persevering faith, those' final unbelief) — then Gospel preaching toward the reprobate, from God's nearest precise intention, will be a ministry of condemnation, and will not be set before them from God's first intention to work their salvation, but as a medium subordinated to damnation in executing the reprobation decree. That fights the Gospel ministry head-on, since from God's first intention it is a ministry of life.
source_text: Si ponamus electionem et reprobationem ex mera libertate Divinae voluntatis pendentem, et non ex discriminatis actibus ipsorum electorum et reprobatorum (puta horum poenitentia, illorum impoenitentia, horum fide perseverante, illorum finali infidelitate): tum Evangelii praedicatio quoad reprobatos ex proxima et precisa Dei intentione erit ministerium condemnationis, et non proponetur ipsis ex prima Dei intentione ad salutem ipsorum operandam, sed ut medium exsequendo decreto reprobationis damnationi subordinatum. At hoc directe cum ministerio Evangelii pugnat, utpote quod ex prima Dei intentione est ministerium vitae.
